segments.oily: Reviewers who describe their own skin as oily generally report the serum absorbs well without triggering new blemishes, though a few say it can feel slightly rich or heavy, especially under makeup in summer, and one long-term user noticed both the effect and her skin's oiliness returning by the third bottle.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with visible sebaceous filaments and one with severe dehydration and redness, mostly report good hydration without irritation, though a couple of reviews caution that very dry skin may need an extra moisturizer layered on top since the serum alone can feel insufficient.
segments.combination: Combination skin, most often described as 'combination dehydrated' with an oily T-zone and drier areas elsewhere, is the most represented skin type in these reviews, and reviewers consistently say it keeps their skin balanced without tipping into excess oil or dryness, though one notes it starts to feel a bit sticky once the weather warms and her skin turns oilier.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin describe the serum as calming and non-irritating, reporting no new blemishes and some reduction in redness; one reviewer disagrees, saying she would not recommend it for sensitive skin after it caused a stinging sensation when her skin was already irritated, and a couple of others advise patch-testing or avoiding use when skin is not in good condition.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report solid hydration, several calling it their go-to for severe dryness or dehydration and recommending it specifically for combination-dehydrated skin; a handful of reviews caution that on very dry skin it can feel a bit lacking used alone and works best layered with a separate moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Reviewers consistently report calmer, less red-looking skin, including faster fading of post-blemish redness and, in a few cases, overall facial redness and heat visibly reduced within two to three days; no reviewer in this sample reports redness getting worse.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers describe the serum as gentle and non-irritating, several saying their skin barrier felt stronger or calmer with continued use and recommending it for compromised or reactive skin; one reviewer disagrees, reporting a stinging sensation when her skin was already irritated and advising against it for sensitive skin, and a couple of others suggest patch-testing first or avoiding use when skin is not in good condition.
concerns.spots: Reviewers widely report dark marks, acne scars and post-blemish pigmentation gradually fading with consistent use over several weeks to months, usually describing the change as gradual rather than dramatic; several reviewers push back on the product's 'trace/scar' claims, saying it made no difference on heavier pigmentation or that early fading noticeably slowed with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report fewer or fading blemishes and breakouts with consistent daily use, often over two or more weeks, with several long-term users on their third or fourth bottle citing continued improvement; a notable minority instead say it made no visible difference, that early improvement faded over time, or that applying more than the recommended amount led to more breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin, or whose combination skin turns oilier in warm weather, frequently describe the serum as leaving a rich or slightly sticky residue and suggest applying it only at night or in smaller amounts; other reviewers, particularly with combination-dehydrated skin in cooler months, instead describe the texture as light and non-greasy.

extraits.texte: It's quite hydrating and leaves a rich feel on the skin after application. The absorption rate seems to be moderate. Despite being marketed as a blemish serum, it didn't make even the slightest difference in fading marks. I was seriously questioning if I was using the right product. If you're planning to buy this to get rid of blemishes, please, for your own sake, don't. It leaves a slightly rich feeling after application, so those with oily or combination dehydrated skin might want to steer clear. If you skip toner pads and just use a mist before applying this serum, it seems to reduce the rich feeling somewhat. But let me be crystal clear ­ it absolutely does not eliminate it completely!

The reviewer has dry skin with sebaceous filaments and found the product to be generally good for hydration without causing irritation. However, they were disappointed that it didn't live up to its claims of treating blemishes or spots.

extraits.titre: I was really surprised when I...
extraits.texte: I was really surprised when I first used this product. The traces faded noticeably and my skin tone felt a bit more refined, which I really liked. What I liked the most was that it didn't make my skin overly oily, so I was able to maintain a fresh complexion all day long. As someone with an oily skin type, I can't use just anything, but this one didn't cause any breakouts and instead gave me a more stabilized feeling. Despite that, the reason I want to recommend this product is because the effects were just so good when I first used it. Even though I have sensitive skin, there were no issues with breakouts, and the improvement was quite dramatic in a short period of time, which I genuinely appreciated. I think the reaction might vary depending on one's skin condition and the season, but if you have similar skin concerns as I do, this is definitely a product worth trying out. unfortunately, from the third bottle onwards, the effect seems to have diminished a bit... i didn't feel the traces fading as quickly as in the beginning, and the oiliness has increased more than before... it was really impressive at first, but as time passed, that impression gradually faded, so i was a little disappointed. of course, it's not that the effect has completely disappeared, and it's still decent. it's just that the level of satisfaction wasn't as high as when i first used it. The ampoule has a slight oily residue, so it's recommended to use it only at night for oily skin.

extraits.titre: I've been using this for about...
extraits.texte: I've been using this for about 5 months. While there weren't any dramatic changes, I noticed a slight reduction in redness. It seems to work well on minor blemishes with mild redness, rather than deep, scar­like marks. Overall, I've seen a subtle improvement in my skin texture. After application, my skin feels excessively oily... Even though I don't typically have very oily skin, this product makes my face incredibly shiny. I wouldn't recommend it for those with sensitive skin. In my case, when my skin was slightly irritated, using this product caused a slight stinging sensation. As mentioned earlier, it doesn't seem effective on deeper blemishes.

Application: Just like the familiar feeling when applying your usual serum! It's not very viscous and glides on smoothly, with a slight tendency to run when applied directly to the skin. Absorption: While not entirely water­like in texture, it has that typical serum consistency that absorbs quickly. It's perfect for combination dehydrated skin that doesn't like oiliness. Those with dry skin might feel immediate dryness if used alone. Recommended Skin Type: Highly recommended for skin with blemish marks! I occasionally get breakouts, so while I don't have many significant marks, I've seen quite good results! It seems more effective on acne scars rather than dark spots, and you can really see improvement, especially on newer marks! I'm on my second bottle thanks to a buy­one­get­one deal, and so far, I haven't found any downsides! I've heard it works well with microneedling, so I tried it ­ and the results were truly impressive! I used it every night along with 1.0mm microneedling, and it was quite effective for treating marks. However, I didn't notice significant effects when using it alone.

I've been using the Madecassoside Blemish Repair Serum for a few weeks now, and the results have exceeded my expectations. The serum effectively reduces redness, soothes irritation, and helps heal breakouts faster. The texture is light, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a sticky feeling. I especially appreciate that it doesn't cause tightness or trigger new blemishes. It's suitable even for my sensitive skin. A big plus is the formula with madecassoside — it truly works. My skin looks more even and well­cared for. I'll definitely be ordering it again! Highly recommend for anyone with sensitive or acne­prone skin.
